chapter: After the music: Army, public service, family
title: His daughter's music; never played with string bands
summary: His daughter is a union musician; he has three children. He never played with string bands like Doc Souchon's.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: What about your daughter? Does she still play music? Oh, yeah.
She's in the union. My daughter's in the union. She's accomplished. She's very good. She plays wonderfully. She's married. I have three children. They live up in Metairick.
And did you ever play with any of those string bands like Doc Sushan used to play with, like the Six and Seven, Eight?
No, no, I never did. You didn't know that? I used to do that. Yeah, I never did.
Did you hear them ever? No. Yeah, well, that record they made is just beautiful, you know. Yeah. There is one record of them. Mm-hmm. And why not?
Well, I possibly heard the record, I guess. Mm-hmm. It's possible I did.
Gee, there's so many people I want to ask you about, and it's so hard to think of them now at a time like this.
Well, you about mentioned everyone that in the old days I think I can think of.
